hypothesis: Neutral image framing and distinguishing uncertain food presence from uncertain recipe identity might reduce object/shape clues without excluding unfamiliar food categories. This was a hypothesis, not an established cause.

method.inputs: Same original exposed P01-P12 bytes/order as the previous build6 qualitative run; prior input credits/rights remain in new-public-meals-20261024.json.
method.comparison: One prior baseline and one later candidate call per image, separated in time. Not randomized or causal; no reruns or replacement.
method.expectations: Pre-frozen broad visual expectations from two blind AI pixel reviews; not qualified human/nutrition/material/clinical truth.
method.newEightStatus: Separate collected, pixel-only AI-reviewed expectations agree on5 recognizable food/drink,1 clear nonfood and2 uncertain; remain unrun. Intended source-selection strata are not truth labels.
method.rawDiagnosticLimit: Only final policy-filtered names are exposed; raw visibleFood, rejected strings, confidence and empty-list reasons are unavailable.

mechanicalResults.runtimeStorageFlagLimit: storageTouched=false means the saved-meal-review store API was not invoked; QA wrote an isolated report and attempt marker.

adoptionDecision.criterion: Require an inspected-empty accepted-name list, fixed before inference. No confidence field exists; all-clues-are-tentative wording cannot waive it.
adoptionDecision.foodUsefulnessGate: Not demonstrated for all eight; P04 lost a broad compatible clue and the sole dumpling label was unsupported by the frozen broad visual description. P08 introduced unconfirmed specificity. This is AI appearance review, not proof of a recipe being impossible or hidden ingredient absent.

gateAssessment.basis: All12 completed inspected responses; zero components/included, absent automatic total, false readiness, one photo, source contract, no label/Vision fallback and no stop reasons.
P02/P06/P12 each returned inspected-empty, not unavailable/error.

P07 returned brown dessert. The pre-inference clarification and contract require inspected-empty; tentative UI language and absent confidence fields do not waive it. Material/edibility remains uncertain.

gateAssessment.gate: food-like broad usefulness/no new plainly incompatible clue
gateAssessment.basis: P04 only returns dumpling, which this reviewer cannot support as a broad compatible category for the frozen flat-round appearance. P08 adds unsupported garlic and more specific recipe identities; distinguish unsupported specificity from a proved absent ingredient or categorically false recipe. Some other food-like cases retain useful broad clues. P07 already independently fails the overall gate.
Any failed fixed gate prevents adoption on this experiment. P07 alone is decisive; retain P04/P08 contrary evidence rather than summarizing all inspected lists as success.

Passing the exposed gates would still not authorize shipping; here they failed. New8 remains unrun and is not substituted for a failed case. This review neither authorizes another inference nor changes a proposal.

cases.assessment: Identical final list. Rice and salad fit the separate rice mound and slaw; meat is a qualified broad hypothesis for the browned piece. Drink remains bottle-context inference, not direct confirmation of contents. No new recipe, flavor or nutrition claim is established.

cases.finding: Observed nonfood abstention replaces object clue
cases.assessment: The prior ceramic bowl output described a nonfood vessel in the food-clue channel. The candidate returned inspected-empty, meeting this fixed nonfood development gate. This is a useful observed change, not proof of causation, stable object rejection or material identity.

Lasagna is unchanged. The closed pale topping/red-edge baked dish is compatible with a casserole-like category, but pasta, layers and filling are not exposed. A plausible exact recipe remains unconfirmed; it is not proof of that recipe being absent.

cases.finding: Lost broad compatible clue; new poor-fit label
cases.assessment: Flatbread was replaced by dumpling. Reopened original pixels still show overlapping flattened pale rounds with browned spots under wrapping, as both pre-inference blind reviews recorded. This reviewer cannot establish dumpling as a broad compatible clue from the visible form; no exact bread word is required, but a nonempty food noun alone does not satisfy usefulness. This is an appearance-fit judgment, not qualified recipe truth or proof that a regional dumpling variant is impossible.

Pâté became patties while sauce remained. Patties is a closer broad appearance description for discrete browned pieces with a coarse green interior than the previous spread-like recipe label. Sauce fits the smooth pale base. Neither interior ingredients nor sauce composition is established. This individual observed improvement is not a causal or persistent prompt-performance claim.
Inspected-empty on the sponge-like utility object is retained. It is not an error fallback, and neither raw visibleFood nor the policy reason for emptiness is available.

Brown square became brown dessert. The central wick-like strand and material ambiguity remain as frozen before inference. The clarification explicitly required inspected-empty, and the schema has no confidence field. A nonempty dessert name fails that gate even when app-wide copy calls clues tentative. The object is not relabeled certainly edible or certainly nonfood, and its material is not inferred.

cases.finding: New unsupported identities and recipe specificity
cases.assessment: Curry/flatbread/fried potatoes became dal/chapati/potato/garlic. Potato remains a qualified compatible side clue, and removing fried avoids that particular preparation assertion. Dal is a plausible but unconfirmed legume-dish identity for the yellow grain/porridge-like base; its composition is not visible proof. Chapati is more recipe-specific than the broad thin round blistered crisp/flatbread-like observation. Reopened pixels and both blind reports establish no clear garlic; the conspicuous purple-white segment is onion-like. Garlic is a new unsupported ingredient identity, without claiming hidden garlic is absent. Returned names have no location mapping, so do not assign dal to the base or cropped bowl as fact.

cases.finding: Same clue set; unresolved vegetable specificity
cases.assessment: Only list order changed. Chicken and carrots remain appearance-compatible; potatoes may fit some larger pale ovals, not every white oval. Green beans remains unconfirmed and a weaker fit than the frozen broad long-ridged-green-vegetable category. No replacement species, hidden grain base or exhaustive egg recall is imposed.

Dumplings is unchanged and fits the visible browned crescent parcels. Closed wrappers establish no filling or regional recipe. Omission of the cropped dark liquid is not a failure under the non-exhaustive expectations.

cases.finding: Visible mixed-dish decomposition persists; side clue lost
cases.assessment: Fried egg/noodles/shrimp remain while lime was removed. These retained words have visible appearance support; fried egg is familiar appearance shorthand, not proof of cooking technique or oil. Egg and shrimp are mixed-dish elements rather than concealed ingredient guesses, but the list still decomposes one noodle dish. Lime was a compatible separately served citrus clue in the baseline; losing it is an observed utility loss, not an automatic exhaustive-recall gate failure.
Inspected-empty on the yarn skeins is retained. This single observation does not establish reliable nonfood behavior in general.

limits: Exposed, purposive, AI-reviewed development comparison, not qualified ground truth, an accuracy percentage or held-out acceptance.
No causal, repeatability, worldwide-food, nutrition, dose, clinical or competitive-superiority claim.

QA lifecycle and model instructions differ from production; no full production UI, physical camera/device, airplane-mode/network-isolation, performance/memory/thermal/battery or OS compute-release proof.
Apple guided output constrains format, not semantic correctness. A typed abstention schema remains an unimplemented alternative, not a demonstrated fix.
Four longer prompt surfaces changed together as one proposal; do not attribute an individual output to one clause.
The production preparation and model-control mechanics remain unchanged; remaining app readiness gates remain open.
next: Investigate general food/uncertainty decision architecture and supported local capabilities before freezing another proposal; retain cultural names and useful broad foods. Do not hardcode exposed object/dish names, fit to captions or substitute the unrun8 for failed cases. Continue the exact production photo-to-history journey/accessibility and later physical/applicant/2027 gates.
